desc:
Roman numerals use the symbols I V X L C D M (1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000). A string is a well-formed Roman numeral if it is the standard (canonical) writing of some integer from 1 to 3999. Return true if s is well-formed, otherwise false.

The canonical writing is built decimal digit by decimal digit, from thousands to units:

  • thousands: up to three M;
  • for each of the hundreds, tens and units digit, use one of: nothing, one to three of the "one" symbol (C, X, I), the "five" symbol (D, L, V) optionally followed by one to three "one" symbols, or a subtractive pair: "one" + "five" (CD, XL, IV for 4) or "one" + "ten" (CM, XC, IX for 9).

Valid: I, XLII, MCMXCIV, MMMCMXCIX. Invalid: IIII (use IV), VV, IC (99 is XCIX), MMMM (above 3999), CMC, DCCCC, IXI, VX, ABC.
hints: A valid numeral is a thousands part followed by a hundreds part, a tens part and a units part, always in this order. Each part has a small set of allowed shapes.
Parse greedily with an index: first up to three M; then for each of the three remaining digits try the subtractive pair, otherwise an optional five-symbol followed by at most three one-symbols.

The string is valid only if the index reached the end after the last part, so leftovers such as the second C in CMC or the fifth C in DCCCCC are rejected. Do not forget that a string like VV or IIII is rejected because each part can be used only once.
editorial: Think of the numeral as four independent decimal digits written left to right. The thousands digit is 0-3 copies of M. For each other digit with symbols (one, five, ten) = (C, D, M), (X, L, C), (I, V, X), the allowed spellings are: empty, up to three ones, a pair one+five, a pair one+ten, or the five followed by up to three ones. The spellings of one digit are mutually exclusive, so after matching a pair you must not try to match anything more for that digit.

So parse with an index: read up to three M; for each of the three digit groups, if the text at the index starts with one+ten or one+five consume those two characters, otherwise optionally consume the five symbol and then up to three one symbols. After the last group the index has to equal the length of the string. Any leftover character means a repeated symbol, a wrong order or an illegal subtraction.
Equivalently, the language is the regular expression M{0,3}(CM|CD|D?C{0,3})(XC|XL|L?X{0,3})(IX|IV|V?I{0,3}) (also non-empty). The parse takes O(n) time and O(1) space.
